title: everything’s always coming up audra! #gypsymusical #gypsybroadway #au...
transcript: it's Tonys week! and I am revisiting some of the shows that I saw early in the Tony season but haven't seen since so we're starting with Gypsy Gypsy is nominated for five Tony Awards including Revival Audra McDonald Danny Burstein Joy Woods and Best Choreography for Camille A. Brown and I haven't seen it since I think previews so it's definitely time to revisit so I'm really excited to return also because I think this is gonna be a very different experience I can't believe I'm seeing rose’s turn right there this was one of the most magical theatre experiences I've ever had I love seeing a show early in previews but previews are very much a work in progress so getting to see the show where it is now everyone has incredible chemistry they sound great there are moments in the show that destroyed me and Audra McDonald is the greatest on broadway she is emotion and intensity and just breaks your heart her rose’s turn will sit with me forever I'm so glad I got to come back to this show I love Gypsy so much and I'm so excited for the Tony Awards on Sunday
reasoning: Creator describes it as 'one of the most magical theatre experiences' they've ever had, praises Audra McDonald as 'the greatest on Broadway,' and says moments in the show 'destroyed' them. Unambiguous rave.
keyQuote: this was one of the most magical theatre experiences I've ever had
